correctness.rationale: Distinct two-deletion shadows, not embeddings, are used. The 4->2 one-center bound is at most binom(4,2)=6<9, and explicit two-word cover attains two. For n=5, any four-center cover must cover 000,111,222, requiring a distinct majority-a word for each a; each majority class has 51 members. Independently enumerated all 132651 majority triples and the 15141-element downset generated by every fourth-center shadow: no triple complement belongs to it. The four-word witness covers exactly 26; the five-word codebook covers all 27. For n=6, independently computed the ten-class nonnegative integer weight table total 90, and max weighted 2-deletion shadow 11 over all 729 source words; hence any cover has at least ceil(90/11)=9 words. The nine cyclic alphabet translates of three source words cover 81 targets exactly. The upper and lower certificates are exhaustive over the finite asserted dimensions, not a proposed infinite family.
